profiles.description: Valuation snapshot: current market worth of all investment holdings. The total account balance measured at market prices.
Cash contribution received: the investor deposits new savings, adds funds, pays money in, tops up the portfolio. Fresh capital transferred into the account from an outside bank.
Cash withdrawal paid out: the investor takes money out, removes funds from the portfolio and spends the proceeds elsewhere. Capital leaves the account for an outside purchase.
